title: Printable tally and frequency templates
subject: Mathematics
source: Seeded from mathematics/y8 lesson 76 (Printable tally and frequency templates)
intro: Lesson 76: Frequency tables and grouped data. To understand how to organise discrete and continuous data in frequency tables, including grouped tables

questions.model: Tally each value once: 1 (2), 2 (3), 3 (4), 4 (1). Check the total: 2 + 3 + 4 + 1 = 10.

questions.q: Class for t = 30 in the reading table?
How many read for under 20 minutes?
Group these 16 heights (cm, example data) into classes of width 10 from 130: 134, 141, 156, 149, 138, 152, 145, 160, 147, 139, 155, 143, 151, 136, 148, 158
questions.model: Tally 134 in 130 ≤ h < 140, 141 in 140 ≤ h < 150, and so on; 160 goes in 160 ≤ h < 170. Check the total is 16.

questions.q: What information is lost when data is grouped?
questions.a: The exact values: we only know which class each is in

questions.q: Suggest classes for journey times from 3 to 47 minutes and explain your choice.
questions.a: For example 0 ≤ t < 10 up to 40 ≤ t < 50: equal widths of 10, five classes cover all values

questions.q: Frequency of 20 ≤ t < 30 in the reading table
Big question: when should we group data?
questions.a: When there are many different values, especially continuous data.
